description: Defines the class MultiMappedOutboundSignal which models outbound signals mapped from a single signal, including methods for JSON serialization, equality, and accessors.

classes.name: MultiMappedOutboundSignal
classes.description: Represents outbound signals mapped from a single source signal, with methods for JSON conversion, equality, and access to signals and sender.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on outbound signals and sender.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on outbound signals and sender.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source signal of the first mapped outbound signal.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the targets of the first mapped outbound signal.

methods.name: getMappedOutboundSignals
methods.description: Returns the list of mapped outbound signals.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the sender ActorRef if present.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first mapped outbound signal.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JsonObject, including mapped signals and sender.
